branches.name: master
branches.about: The only long-lived branch. Work is at an early stage and activity is occasional.

branches.name: main

repos.name: OpenRAC
repos.title: OpenRAC launcher
repos.about: The launcher and native PC port that bring the decompilations together.

branches.name: develop
branches.about: Day-to-day development. Work lands here through squash-merged pull requests, and Development channel builds follow it.

branches.name: master
branches.about: The stable line. Protected, and it moves only through a release pull request from develop, so activity here usually means a release.
